# Final attempt using dataset-qualified external tables for resolution, then only T tables for directories.
import pandas as pd

result = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
WITH members AS (
  SELECT mld.moira_list_key,
         lower(trim(mld.moira_list_member)) AS member_ident
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  WHERE mld.moira_list_member IS NOT NULL AND trim(mld.moira_list_member) <> ''
),
unique_members AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key, member_ident
  FROM members
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
-- Resolve Kerberos -> email using retrieved beaver.warehouse_users and beaver.employee_directory
wh_emails AS (
  SELECT lower(trim(krb_name)) AS krb,
         lower(trim(email_address)) AS email
  FROM beaver.warehouse_users
  WHERE krb_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(krb_name) <> '' AND email_address IS NOT NULL AND trim(email_address) <> ''
),
emp_krb AS (
  SELECT lower(trim(krb_name)) AS krb,
         lower(trim(email_address)) AS email
  FROM beaver.employee_directory
  WHERE krb_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(krb_name) <> '' AND email_address IS NOT NULL AND trim(email_address) <> ''
),
krb_to_email AS (
  SELECT krb, email FROM wh_emails
  UNION ALL
  SELECT krb, email FROM emp_krb
),
email_resolved AS (
  SELECT um.moira_list_key,
         COALESCE(ke.email,
                  CASE WHEN strpos(um.member_ident,'@') > 0 THEN um.member_ident ELSE NULL END) AS email
  FROM unique_members um
  LEFT JOIN krb_to_email ke ON um.member_ident = ke.krb
),
resolved AS (
  SELECT er.moira_list_key,
         lower(trim(er.email)) AS email
  FROM email_resolved er
  WHERE er.email IS NOT NULL AND trim(er.email) <> ''
),
-- Department and student flag from T directories by email
stud_by_email AS (
  SELECT lower(trim(email_address)) AS email,
         coalesce(nullif(trim(department_name),''),'Unknown') AS dept_from_stud,
         CASE WHEN student_year IS NOT NULL AND trim(student_year) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_student
  FROM mit_student_directory
  WHERE email_address IS NOT NULL AND trim(email_address) <> ''
),
emp_by_email AS (
  SELECT lower(trim(email_address)) AS email,
         coalesce(nullif(trim(department_name),''),'Unknown') AS dept_from_emp
  FROM employee_directory
  WHERE email_address IS NOT NULL AND trim(email_address) <> ''
),
resolved_with_attrs AS (
  SELECT r.moira_list_key,
         r.email,
         COALESCE(s.dept_from_stud, e.dept_from_emp, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
         COALESCE(s.is_student, 0) AS is_student
  FROM resolved r
  LEFT JOIN stud_by_email s ON r.email = s.email
  LEFT JOIN emp_by_email e ON r.email = e.email
),
list_counts AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key, COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS total_subscribers
  FROM resolved_with_attrs
  GROUP BY 1
),
by_dept AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key, department_name,
         COUNT(*) AS members_in_dept,
         SUM(is_student) AS students_in_dept
  FROM resolved_with_attrs
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT bd.moira_list_key,
         bd.department_name,
         bd.members_in_dept,
         bd.students_in_dept,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bd.moira_list_key ORDER BY bd.members_in_dept DESC, bd.department_name) AS rn
  FROM by_dept bd
),
max_dept AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key,
         department_name AS top_department_name,
         students_in_dept AS top_department_students
  FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
list_meta AS (
  SELECT ml.moira_list_key,
         ml.moira_list_name,
         CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ml.is_public,'N')) = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_public
  FROM moira_list ml
)
SELECT lm.moira_list_name AS list_name,
       lc.total_subscribers,
       lm.is_public,
       md.top_department_name,
       md.top_department_students
FROM list_counts lc
JOIN list_meta lm USING (moira_list_key)
LEFT JOIN max_dept md USING (moira_list_key)
ORDER BY lc.total_subscribers DESC, lm.moira_list_name
LIMIT 100
""")

db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, result, "conductor_s_execution")
